name: Rivet Engine
description: Rivet is an open alternative to Cloudflare Durable Objects. Rivet Actors are long-lived stateful processes with their own SQLite database that run inside your Node.js, Bun or Rust apps, while the engine schedules, routes and persists them. This is the self-hosted engine those apps connect to.

notes.text: Connect your RivetKit app with RIVET_ENDPOINT=http://default:<token>@<IP>:6420, using auth.admin_token from /opt/rivet_data/config.json. The default node pool already exists.
Port 6420 is the API and actor gateway, not a web UI; the self-hosted engine ships no dashboard.
The admin token has full access to every namespace. Keep it on your backend and put the engine behind HTTPS before exposing it beyond your LAN.

app_vars.name: var_admin_token
app_vars.label: Admin Token
app_vars.help: Generated when left empty. Use letters and digits only, it is embedded in RIVET_ENDPOINT
